identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Preserve blocked and unstable PR mergeability states

values.task_boundary: Repair the bounded mergeability mapping and prove its state table before execution.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every supported mergeability variant has an explicit classification
AC-2: blocked and unstable cannot be reported as stale_base
AC-3: behind remains stale_base and dirty remains conflicted
AC-4: Focused tests prove the table and csdlc-merge remains fail-closed until clean ancestry and required checks are observed
dependencies: Existing csdlc-pr-state classification and merge gate tests
non_goals: No provider, Runtime, AWS, or CI workflow changes
